	I made debug* (I didn't know enough at the time to call it
NDEBUG) be upward compatable with the only other debug I knew of at
the time.  I didn't know about your debug until today.  I think that
a merger of the two versions is the only GOOD solution.  I would
be glad to spend a little time helping that along.  My version is
very old, and is written in very old lisp using a bunch of my
macros.  It should be rewritten anyway.  I would be glad to rewrite my
version in vanilla lisp, and cooperate on a joint command set, if
you would add the features you have a particular knowledge of into it.
There is no reason that we should continue with three versions of DEBUG.

			Dick
